data.name: customSqlQuery1.Sql
data.value: SELECT D.ItemCode, D.Qty, D.TotalPrice, M.SalesDate, M.BillToCode, it.ItemClass1, cci.Title AS ItemClass1Name FROM BM_SalesD D INNER JOIN BM_SalesM M ON D.Corpid = M.CorpId AND D.SalesNo= M.SalesNo LEFT JOIN CM_Item it ON D.CorpId = it.CorpId AND D.ItemCode = it.ItemCode LEFT JOIN CM_Cateitem cci ON D.CorpId = cci.CorpId AND it.ItemClass1 = cci.ClassItemCode AND cci.Class = 'A01210' WHERE D.CorpId = @pCorpId AND M.SalesDate BETWEEN @pStartDate AND @pEndDate

data.name: customSqlQuery2.Sql
data.value: SELECT SA.ThisMonthSalesAmt AS [원 매출액] , SA.LastMonthSalesAmt AS [원 매출액전월] , CASE WHEN SA.LastMonthSalesAmt > 0 THEN ((SA.ThisMonthSalesAmt - SA.LastMonthSalesAmt) / SA.LastMonthSalesAmt) * 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS [매출전월대비] , SU.ThisMonthSujuAmt AS [목표액(수주액)] , SU.LastMonthSujuAmt AS [목표액전월] , CASE WHEN SU.ThisMonthSujuAmt > 0 THEN (SA.ThisMonthSalesAmt / SU.ThisMonthSujuAmt) * 100.0 ELSE 0 END AS [목표달성률] , DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), EOMONTH(GETDATE())) AS [잔여일] , 0 AS [수주 잔고] , SU.ThisMonthSujuCnt AS [신규수주 마스터 건수] , (SU.ThisMonthSujuCnt - SU.LastMonthSujuCnt) AS [신규수주 마스터 전월대비 건수] , SU.ThisMonthSujuDetailCnt AS [신규수주 디테일 건수] , (SU.ThisMonthSujuDetailCnt - SU.LastMonthSujuDetailCnt) AS [신규수주 디테일 전월대비 건수] , CASE WHEN DV.ThisMonthDeliveryTotal > 0 THEN (DV.ThisMonthDeliveryOnTime * 100.0 / DV.ThisMonthDeliveryTotal) ELSE 0 END AS [납기 준수율%] , CASE WHEN DV.LastMonthDeliveryTotal > 0 THEN (DV.LastMonthDeliveryOnTime * 100.0 / DV.LastMonthDeliveryTotal) ELSE 0 END AS [납기 준수율 전월] , (CASE WHEN DV.ThisMonthDeliveryTotal > 0 THEN (DV.ThisMonthDeliveryOnTime * 100.0 / DV.ThisMonthDeliveryTotal) ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN DV.LastMonthDeliveryTotal > 0 THEN (DV.LastMonthDeliveryOnTime * 100.0 / DV.LastMonthDeliveryTotal) ELSE 0 END) AS [납기 전월대비p] , DV.TodayDeliveryExpectedDetailCnt AS [금일 납기 예정 건수] , SA.TodaySalesDetailCnt AS [금일 출하 건수] FROM ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate >= DT.TM_Start THEN D.TotalPrice ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ThisMonthSujuAmt , ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate < DT.TM_Start THEN D.TotalPrice ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LastMonthSujuAmt , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate >= DT.TM_Start THEN M.SdOrderNo END) AS ThisMonthSujuCnt , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate < DT.TM_Start THEN M.SdOrderNo END) AS LastMonthSujuCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate >= DT.TM_Start THEN D.SdOrderSeq END) AS ThisMonthSujuDetailCnt , COUNT(CASE WHEN M.ObtainDate < DT.TM_Start THEN D.SdOrderSeq END) AS LastMonthSujuDetailCnt FROM ( SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AS LM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AS TM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) AS NM_Start ) AS DT INNER JOIN BM_SdOrderM M ON M.CorpId = @CorpId AND M.ObtainDate >= DT.LM_Start AND M.ObtainDate < DT.NM_Start LEFT JOIN BM_SdOrderD D ON M.CorpId = D.CorpId AND M.SdOrderNo = D.SdOrderNo ) AS SU CROSS JOIN ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SM.SalesDate >= DT.TM_Start THEN SD.TotalPrice ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ThisMonthSalesAmt , ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SM.SalesDate < DT.TM_Start THEN SD.TotalPrice ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LastMonthSalesAmt , COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(SM.SalesDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN SD.SalesNo END) AS TodaySalesDetailCnt FROM ( SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AS LM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AS TM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) AS NM_Start ) AS DT INNER JOIN BM_SalesM SM ON SM.CorpId = @CorpId AND SM.SalesDate >= DT.LM_Start AND SM.SalesDate < DT.NM_Start LEFT JOIN BM_SalesD SD ON SM.CorpId = SD.CorpId AND SM.SalesNo = SD.SalesNo ) AS SA CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OM.DeliveryDate >= DT.TM_Start THEN SD.SdOrderNo END) AS ThisMonthDeliveryTotal , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OM.DeliveryDate >= DT.TM_Start AND SM.SalesDate <= OM.DeliveryDate THEN SD.SdOrderNo END) AS ThisMonthDeliveryOnTime , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OM.DeliveryDate < DT.TM_Start THEN SD.SdOrderNo END) AS LastMonthDeliveryTotal , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN OM.DeliveryDate < DT.TM_Start AND SM.SalesDate <= OM.DeliveryDate THEN SD.SdOrderNo END) AS LastMonthDeliveryOnTime , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(OM.DeliveryDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN OD.SdOrderNo + '_' + CAST(OD.SdOrderSeq AS VARCHAR) END) AS TodayDeliveryExpectedDetailCnt FROM ( SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0) AS LM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0) AS TM_Start , DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()) + 1, 0) AS NM_Start ) AS DT INNER JOIN BM_SdOrderM OM ON OM.CorpId = @CorpId AND OM.DeliveryDate >= DT.LM_Start AND OM.DeliveryDate < DT.NM_Start LEFT JOIN BM_SdOrderD OD ON OM.CorpId = OD.CorpId AND OM.SdOrderNo = OD.SdOrderNo LEFT JOIN BM_SalesD SD ON OD.CorpId = SD.CorpId AND OD.SdOrderNo = SD.SdOrderNo AND OD.SdOrderSeq = SD.SdOrderSeq LEFT JOIN BM_SalesM SM ON SD.CorpId = SM.CorpId AND SD.SalesNo = SM.SalesNo ) AS DV

data.name: customSqlQuery3.Sql
data.value: select D.SdOrderNo, D.ItemCode, D.Qty, D.TotalPrice, M.ObtainDate, M.SoldToCode, M.DeliveryDate, CC.CustName, it.ItemName, it.Size, D.OrderStatus from dbo.BM_SdOrderD D inner join dbo.BM_SdOrderM M on M.CorpId = D.CorpId and (M.SdOrderNo = D.SdOrderNo) left join dbo.CM_Cust CC on (CC.CustCode = M.SoldToCode) left join dbo.CM_Item it on (it.CorpId = D.CorpId) and (it.ItemCode = D.ItemCode) where D.CorpId = @pCorpId AND M.ObtainDate BETWEEN @pStartDate AND @pEndDate

data.name: customSqlQuery4.Sql
data.value: SELECT M.BillToCode, cc.CustName BillToName, SUM(D.TotalPrice) TotalPrice FROM BM_SalesD D INNER JOIN BM_SalesM M ON D.CorpId = M.CorpId AND D.SalesNo = M.SalesNo LEFT JOIN CM_Cust cc ON D.CorpId = cc.CorpId AND M.BillToCode = cc.CustCode WHERE D.CorpId = @CorpId AND ISNULL(M.BillToCode, '') <> '' AND M.SalesDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate GROUP BY M.BillToCode, cc.CustName ORDER BY TotalPrice DESC
